purpose: Guarded research fork of fflate0.8.3, not unmodified upstream. Fixed output storage, exact stream extent, reserved-symbol rejection, strict dynamic Huffman grammar and caller-supplied history-window bounds.
patch_application: Apply every exact before/after replacement once in order to unchanged upstream, then append the literal append field. The inflate.test.mjs provenance case reconstructs the complete fork.

sources.use: Canonical trees, literal EOB, reserved symbols and literal-only or one-bit distance alphabets.
Kraft over/undersubscription checks, complete code-length alphabet and one-bit lit/dist exception; empty distance alphabet errors only when used.
Native default count limits HLIT<=286 and HDIST<=30. INFLATE_STRICT controls advertised history-window enforcement in zlib builds.
CINFO declares a window of 2^(8+CINFO) bytes; valid CINFO0..7 remains accepted.

contract_notes: RFC1951 encodes HDIST counts up to32; this strict fork deliberately follows the default zlib header acceptance limit30 even when trailing reserved entries are unused.

Code-length trees must be complete. Literal/distance trees permit the native one-bit singleton exception. Literal alphabets require symbol256. Empty distance alphabets are allowed for literal-only blocks.
The bounded wrapper supplies the advertised zlib history window. Raw callers may omit the third argument for32768; explicit undefined, invalid types, nonpowers of two and out-of-range windows reject.
Actual streams retain CINFO7/32768-byte history. Strict advertised-window rejection may differ from native zlib builds without INFLATE_STRICT; diagnostics preserve the observed native behavior.
